Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

kstools 0.6.0

Bug fixes and behavior changes (LLM panel review round 1, docs/reviews/2026-10-25-llm-panel)

  • ks_write_xpt(): non-finite numeric values (Inf, -Inf) were silently written as 0. They are now mapped to SAS missing (.) like NA_real_ and NaN (round-1 A2).
  • ks_write_xpt(): SAS XPORT interoperability limits now abort instead of silently truncating: variable names must be <= 8 bytes (v5) / <= 32 bytes (v8), column labels <= 40 / 256 bytes, and character data must fit 200 bytes at version 5 (SAS XPORT engine limit, Tech Note 1528) and 32767 bytes at version 8. Case-insensitive name collisions are rejected (round-1 A4).
  • ks_write_xpt(): a failed write no longer leaves a partial .xpt file behind (round-1 A9).
  • String widths on write are computed in bytes via LENGTH(); embedded NUL bytes no longer truncate the stored value silently (round-1 A10).
  • ks_read_xpt() (internal parser): files declaring a numeric variable with a storage width other than 8 bytes are now rejected with a clear error instead of silently decoding shifted garbage (round-1 A8).
  • ks_impute_dtc(): out-of-range components (month 13, day beyond month length incl. leap years, hour 24-25, minute/second > 59) were silently rolled over by make_datetime() (2020-13-01 -> 2021-01-01). Such elements now follow the documented non-matching contract: NA value and NA imputation flag, never imputed from ref (round-1 A3).
  • ks_auc(): groups with fewer than two concurrent non-NA (value, time) points now return NA_real_ instead of a misleading 0 (round-1 A5).
  • ks_batch_load(): if any file fails to load, the function aborts and reports the offending paths (previously try-error objects were kept in the returned list and persisted by save.path/keep) (round-1 A6).
  • ks_roc(): non-numeric predictor columns are rejected with a clear message instead of a cryptic internal type error (round-1 A7).
  • ks_n_pct(): numeric method warns on fractional counts and computes count and percentage from the same truncated integer (the data-frame method already behaved this way) (round-1 A10).
  • ks_supp_merge(): duplicate (key, QNAM) records (which pivot_wider() would silently turn into list-columns) and QNAM values colliding with primary-domain variable names now abort with SDTM-oriented messages (round-1 A10).
  • XPT parallel decode errors now concatenate all worker messages instead of reporting only the first (round-1 A10).
  • ks_mianalyze(): SAS PROC MIANALYZE parity for a zero within-imputation variance: a warning is issued per zero standard error, and when the pooled within variance is 0 the degrees of freedom, MI diagnostics (r, FMI, RE), confidence limits and t-test are NA - previously a degenerate finite df = m - 1 (and an NA-producing qt() call with EDF=) was reported. SAS prints “.” for these values with or without EDF=; estimate, pooled SE, B, T and the ranges remain reported (round-1 A1, closed).

kstools 0.5.9

New features

  • ks_compare_na(): NA-aware element-wise comparison (SAS NULL= twin).
  • ks_vswitch(): vectorized switch over named cases (SAS select-when map), with .na / .default fallbacks.
  • ks_hosmer_lemeshow(): Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit for logistic models.
  • ks_dunnett_crit(): exact Dunnett critical value by inverting the equicorrelated multivariate-t (mnormt, Suggests-guarded).
  • ks_mv_normality(): Mardia skewness/kurtosis in base R (agrees with QuantPsyc::mult.norm) + optional energy test (energy, Suggests).
  • ks_boot_ci(): one-line percentile/BCa bootstrap CI over boot.
  • ks_be_2x2(): 2x2 crossover bioequivalence via nlme::lme with contr.SAS (T-R on the log scale, 90% CI, ratio interval).

kstools 0.5.8

Breaking changes

  • ks_swoe(): vector API — call as ks_swoe(x, y) (e.g. inside dplyr::mutate(SEX_SWOE = ks_swoe(SEX, RESPONSE))). The previous data-frame + NSE / quoted interface is removed.

Documentation

  • Improved Mermaid diagram contrast in the mianalyze vignette for dark RStudio themes.

kstools 0.5.7

Breaking changes

  • Removed functions: ks_check_rules(), ks_collapse_check_msgs(), ks_compare_check_state(), ks_save2xlsx_by().
  • Updated vignettes and documentation to remove references to deleted functions.

Documentation

  • Added vignette mianalyze: Rubin’s rules, Barnard-Rubin edf, and numerical comparison with SAS PROC MIANALYZE (SAS/STAT 12.3 Examples 58.1 / 58.3 and Table 58.2).
  • Added SAS-aligned unit tests in tests/testthat/test-ks_mianalyze-sas.R.
  • Expanded inst/examples for ks_mianalyze() / mianalyze() with SAS Example 58.1 inputs.

kstools 0.5.6

New features

  • ks_mianalyze(): added summary.ks_mianalyze() method that returns structured data frames (variance, diagnostics, estimates, tests) for programmatic access to results.
  • ks_mianalyze(): added knit_print.ks_mianalyze() method for proper rendering in R Markdown and Quarto documents using knitr::kable().
  • ks_mianalyze(): refactored print.ks_mianalyze() to use summary() internally, eliminating code duplication and following R best practices.

kstools 0.5.5

Bug fixes

  • ks_cv(): returns NA_real_ instead of Inf/NaN when the mean of x is zero or NA.
  • ks_z_score(): returns an all-NA vector instead of NaN when the standard deviation of x is zero (constant input).
  • ks_n_pct() (numeric and data.frame methods): cells whose denominator (totals) is zero or NA are now replaced with na.rep rather than silently producing "Inf%" in the formatted string.
  • ks_get_numdec(): groups where every value of var is NA now yield NA_integer_ instead of -Inf (double), preserving the integer column type of NUMDEC.
  • ks_batch_load() (type "xpt"): now calls ks_read_xpt() instead of haven::read_xpt(), restoring date conversion and SAS-attribute handling that were bypassed in the previous implementation.
  • ks_williams(): the treatment-name whitespace check used a double-escaped regex ("\\\\s") that matched a literal \s instead of actual whitespace. Fixed to "\\s".

Performance

  • ks_newcombe_hs() and ks_eairdiff_mn(): replaced Vectorize() wrappers with mapply() + do.call(rbind, ...), giving a material speedup on long input vectors.

kstools 0.5.4

Bug fixes / behaviour change

  • ks_impute_dtc(): date-only strings ("YYYY-MM-DD") with direction = "start" now produce 00:00:00 with imputation_flag = "H" instead of 00:00:00 / NA. Consistent with the direction = "end" (Case D) behaviour added in v0.5.3. A ref-date match (Case C) still takes priority over this start-of-day fallback (Case E).

kstools 0.5.3

Bug fixes / behaviour change

  • ks_impute_dtc(): date-only strings ("YYYY-MM-DD") with direction = "end" now produce 23:59:00 with imputation_flag = "H" instead of 00:00:00 / NA. A ref-date match (Case C) still takes priority over this end-of-day fallback (Case D).

kstools 0.5.2

New features

  • ks_impute_dtc(): new function that parses truncated ISO 8601 date/datetime strings and imputes missing components. Accepts direction = "start", "end", or "no" and an optional ref reference date/datetime vector for same-period guided imputation (Cases A / B / C). Returns a tibble(dt = POSIXct, imputation_flag = chr) for direct use with dplyr::bind_cols().

kstools 0.5.1

Bug fixes

  • rcpp_xpt.cpp: replaced <stdexcept> with <exception> (correct header for std::exception).

kstools 0.5.0

Performance

  • ks_read_xpt() / ks_write_xpt(): completely rewritten C++ engine. Uses POSIX mmap for zero-copy file access, streaming columnar decode directly into pre-allocated R vectors, and a multi-threaded worker pool for numeric columns (n_threads argument, defaults to hw - 1). A 5 GB XPT file now reads in ~4 s at ~1.3 GB/s with parser scratch well below 4 MB (previously > 100 GB RSS). Writer uses a 64 KB output buffer with no in-memory row materialisation. Multi-member files are handled via in-place mmap offsets (no temp files).

kstools 0.4.1

New features

  • ks_get_data(): added xpt_reader argument (and global option kstools.xpt.reader) to select the XPT loading back-end. Use xpt_reader = "internal" (or options(kstools.xpt.reader = "internal")) to suppress the “ignored N trailing byte(s) after row parsing” warning emitted by haven on some XPORT files. "haven" remains the default. When the internal reader is used and the file contains multiple members, the domain slot in the output is a named list of tibbles.

kstools 0.4.0

New features

  • ks_read_xpt(): read SAS XPORT V5/V8/V9 files into tibbles. Variable labels, SAS formats, and informats are preserved as column attributes ("label", "format.sas", "sas.informat"). Multi-member files are returned as a named list of tibbles.
  • ks_write_xpt(): write a data frame to a SAS XPORT V5 or V8 file. Labels and formats can be supplied via column attributes or explicit labels/formats arguments.
  • ks_xpt_labels() / ks_xpt_formats(): extract variable labels and SAS formats from a data frame as named character vectors.
  • ks_set_labels() / ks_set_formats(): set "label" / "format.sas" attributes on selected columns from named character vectors.
  • Date and datetime epoch conversion between SAS (1960-01-01) and R (1970-01-01) is applied automatically; disable with convert_dates = FALSE.
  • IBM hexadecimal floating-point encoding/decoding and SAS tagged-missing values are fully supported.

kstools 0.3.9

Breaking changes

  • ks_get_data(): no longer assigns loaded data to .GlobalEnv. It now returns the data directly — a tibble for a single-domain call, or a named list of tibbles for multi-domain calls. Migrate ks_get_data(dm) to dm <- ks_get_data(dm) and ks_get_data(dm, ae) to dat <- ks_get_data(dm, ae); dm <- dat$dm.

New features

  • ks_get_data(): file lookup against path is now case-insensitive for both stem and extension, so ks_get_data(dm) and ks_get_data(DM) both match dm.xpt, DM.XPT, Dm.Xpt, etc.
  • ks_get_data(): new global option kstools.get_data.case to resolve ambiguity when multiple files share the same stem but differ in case. Accepted values: "error" (default), "first", "lower", "upper".

kstools 0.3.8

Bug fixes

  • ks_mianalyze() / mianalyze(): aligned degrees-of-freedom handling with SAS PROC MIANALYZE behavior by adding edf (SAS EDF= analogue) and applying Barnard-Rubin small-sample adjustment when finite complete-data df are supplied.
  • ks_mianalyze() / mianalyze(): kept backward compatibility for v0 while adding input validation for conflicting edf/v0 specifications.

Documentation

  • Updated function docs and examples for the new edf argument and SAS-style DF behavior.

kstools 0.3.7

Bug fixes

  • ks_mianalyze(): corrected pooled total-variance and Rubin degrees-of-freedom calculations used for multiple-imputation inference.

Documentation

  • Bumped package version metadata and refreshed release documentation.

kstools 0.3.6

Documentation

  • Added pkgdown configuration (_pkgdown.yml) and generated docs site workflow.
  • Added vignettes: getting-started and clinical-workflows.
  • Expanded inst/examples coverage and added run_all_examples.R index runner.
  • Added CI workflow to keep README version badge synchronized with DESCRIPTION.

New functions

  • Added ks_mianalyze() / mianalyze() (Rubin pooling; SAS MIANALYZE analogue).
  • Added ks_roc() (correlated ROC AUC comparison with contrast tests).
  • Added ks_williams() (randomized Williams cross-over design and schedule generator).

Bug fixes

  • ks_collapse_check_msgs(): removed unqualified %>% dependency so function and vignettes run without attaching dplyr.

kstools 0.3.5

Performance

  • ks_save2xlsx_by(): replaced O(N) per-row wb_add_fill() loops with Excel Conditional Formatting rules (wb_add_dxfs_style() + wb_add_conditional_formatting()). Fill calls now scale O(1) per colour key per sheet regardless of row count — e.g. 3,000 wb_add_fill() calls for a 1,000-row / 3-colour sheet become 3 CF rules.

Bug fixes

  • ks_summary() test: fixed case-insensitive regexp match for the “Duplicate names” error so the test no longer fails against the capitalised message.

kstools 0.3.4

Bug fixes

  • ks_z_score(): fixed inverted formula — was returning (mean - x) / sd instead of the correct (x - mean) / sd.
  • read.csv3(): fixed potential crash on end-of-file when readLines() returns character(0) — length() guard now precedes grepl() to avoid a zero-length condition in if().
  • ks_compare_check_state(): removed unused internal ..row_id.. column that was allocated and immediately deleted on every call.
  • ks_median_ci() (boot method): guard against NULL $bca component — boot.ci() omits BCa for very small samples; bounds now fall back to NA_real_ instead of silently dropping vector elements.
  • ks_save2xlsx_by(): removed dead as_table parameter (implementation was already removed in 0.3.3); narrowed status-column fill to the status column only (was incorrectly colouring the entire row); added freeze-pane on the header row; added thin cell borders on all data cells.

Minor improvements

  • ks_cv(), ks_z_score(): replaced bare T with TRUE.
  • ks_del_tmp(): simplified redundant single-character class [t] to t.

kstools 0.3.3

Bug fixes

  • Removed unused labelled import; is_missing is now correctly sourced from ksformat.

kstools 0.3.2

New features

  • Added validation workflow helpers: ks_check_rules(), ks_collapse_check_msgs(), ks_compare_check_state(), and ks_save2xlsx_by().
  • Added label and coding helpers: ks_get_labels() and ks_code_to_fmt().

Dependencies

  • Added imports: ksformat, labelled, openxlsx2, purrr, stringr, and tibble.

kstools 0.3.1

New features

  • read.csv3(): read a CSV file with optional KeyStat comment headers (#NAME$type(length)$Label) for column types and labels.
  • ks_get_data(): new type values "csv" and "csvks" for loading plain CSV and KeyStat-commented CSV domains; .csv is also auto-detected.

kstools 0.3.0

New features

  • ks_summary(): new numdec = TRUE parameter appends a NUMDEC column with the group-level max decimal places of var (via ks_get_numdec logic).
  • ks_current_filename(): detect the basename of the running R script (source or Rscript).
  • ks_get_numdec(): compute max decimal places per group and join as NUMDEC.
  • Second author added: Igor Aleschenkov.

Improvements

  • R/get_numeric.r renamed to R/get_numdec.r for consistency with the exported function name.

kstools 0.2.0

New features

  • ks_summary() accepts optional extras: a named list of functions (f(x, na.rm)) for extra per-group statistics; columns appear after the default summary stats and before cv.

Improvements and fixes

  • ks_simulate_ar1(): validation, reproducibility (seed), MASS:: / stats:: usage, documentation, examples, and tests.
  • ks_geom_mean(), ks_median_ci(), ks_n_pct(), ks_get_data(), ks_swap_cols(), ks_swoe(), and related helpers: refactors, bug fixes, and documentation updates (see git history).
  • Newcombe hybrid score CIs: ks_newcombe_hs(), ks_newcombe_hs_strata().
  • Removed ks_trim in favour of base::trimws(); removed medical-history helpers from earlier versions.

Documentation

  • README and package overview (?kstools) updated; broken cross-references in the package index fixed.

kstools 0.1.0

Initial packaged release.
